name: Against the Storm
short_description: A roguelite city builder: found a settlement in a cursed forest, satisfy the queen, and move on before the storm.
sources: oracle study 2026-10-23 (public knowledge, no store fetch, no game files)
summary: A roguelite city builder: found a settlement in a cursed forest, satisfy the queen, and move on before the storm.

identity.core_loop: Clear glades, build production chains, keep species happy, finish orders before impatience fills.
identity.ui_and_game_feel: Calm building punctuated by rain-season dread; dense but tidy panels.

hud_coverage.method: Oracle study from public knowledge of the game, in our own words; not yet measured on capture

information_grammar.note: Storm seasons recolour the whole map; villager needs are icons over houses; the hostility and impatience meters are overlays.

identity.art_direction: Painterly fantasy diorama with rain and foliage.
identity.audio_mood: Folk instruments that darken in the storm.
identity.lessons_for_abbies_world: One weather signal driving light, music and danger at once is exactly the whole-game-adapts rule.
